text_version.note: Checked 2026-10-14: this is the official publication notice summarising the voorbereidingsbesluit (whole municipality, one year, bouwvergunningen aangehouden, gebruikswijziging verboden), not the besluit text itself. The besluit and verbeelding (plan ID NL.IMRO.0394.VBBdatac2019-C001) were on ruimtelijkeplannen.nl, whose /documents/ paths now 404 after the switch to the Omgevingswet DSO; not found on planviewer.nl (403) or the Haarlemmermeer iBabs council portal.

territorial_scope.description: Applies to the entire municipal territory of Haarlemmermeer as shown on the attached map.

summary.short: Municipal moratorium (voorbereidingsbesluit) adopted by Haarlemmermeer council on 11 July 2019, in force from the day after adoption for one year. Across the whole municipality it holds data-centre building permit applications and prohibits changing land or building use while a new zoning plan is prepared.
summary.long: The Haarlemmermeer municipal council decided on 11 July 2019 to declare a preparatory decision (voorbereidingsbesluit) for the entire municipal territory, as shown on the attached map, and a new zoning plan (bestemmingsplan) is to be prepared. The decision took effect the day after the council adopted it and applies for one year. Its stated purpose is to put the existing situation regarding data centres 'on hold' pending future data-centre policy. Under the Wet algemene bepaling omgevingsrecht, building permit applications for the activity 'bouwen' must be held, and the council prohibited changing the use of land and/or buildings. The text says the same measure was adopted by Amsterdam on the same date, as most data-centre establishment and new applications occur in those two municipalities. The decision and map can be consulted on the ruimtelijkeplannen.nl and municipal websites and at the town hall in Hoofddorp. The text states that no objection or appeal is possible against the decision. No penalties, exemptions or numeric thresholds are stated.

relations.note: The text states that under this Act building-permit applications for the activity of building must be held in abeyance while the moratorium applies. The text does not name it as the legal basis of the preparatory decision.

notes: The document is a Gemeenteblad notice of a council preparatory decision (voorbereidingsbesluit) covering the whole municipal territory; the decision text itself is not included. The stated duration is one year (para. 2: 'geldt voor de periode van één jaar'). The text gives no repeal or end date, so the 'repealed' status comes from registry metadata only. The text does not name the enabling provision of the preparatory decision. Para. 4 says that changing 'de gronden en of bouwwerken' is prohibited; the 'en of' wording is unclear. Para. 4 also contains a garbled sentence on the plan identification number and website. Para. 2 says Amsterdam's council took a parallel preparatory decision on 11 July 2019; no relation is coded because the text does not identify that instrument. Para. 6 states that no objection or appeal is possible against this decision.

thresholds.note: The text sets no numeric cutoff that changes legal treatment. It covers the whole municipal territory (gehele grondgebied) for one year (één jaar), which describes scope in place and duration rather than a threshold. Procedural dates (publication, inspection hours) are not coded.

definitions.note: The text does not define 'datacenters' or any other term determining scope. The preparatory decision (voorbereidingsbesluit) covers all of the municipality's territory and the term 'datacenters' is used without a definition.

enforcement.note: The text states a prohibition on changing the use of land and buildings ("verboden het gebruik van de gronden en of bouwwerken te wijzigen") and a permit-holding duty under the Wet algemene bepaling omgevingsrecht, but states no fine, penalty, criminal sanction, licence revocation, clawback, suspension or blocking. It also states that objection and appeal are not possible, which is not a sanction regime. No enforcement regime is found in this text.
